```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
### ROI
# Define region of interest (roi). The roi must be (1) an sf polygon and (2)
# in the WGS84 (epsg:4326) coordinate reference system. 
roi_sf <- gadm(country = "UGA", level=1, path = tempdir()) 
```

```{r}
roi_sf <- readRDS("gadm41_UGA_1_pk.rds")
```

```{r}
# Read raster for a given month
file_rds <- file.path(getwd(), "bm_outputs", "ntl_2021_10.Rds")
r <- readRDS(file_rds)

#### Prep data
r <- r |> terra::mask(roi_sf)

## Distribution is skewed, so log
r[] <- log(r[] + 1)

# Extract month and year from filename
filename <- basename(file_rds)
parts <- strsplit(gsub("ntl_|\\.Rds", "", filename), "_")[[1]]  # "2021_12"
year_val <- parts[1]
month_val <- parts[2]

# Convert numeric month to month name
month_name <- month.name[as.numeric(month_val)]

##### Map
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black",
                       mid = "yellow",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 2.5,
                       na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = paste("Nighttime Lights:", month_name, year_val)) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
terra::summary(r)
```

head(values(r))
```

```

### Matrix

```{r}
terra::nrow(r)
terra::ncol(r)
terra::ncell(r)
```

```{r}
v <- terra::values(r)

m <- matrix(
  v,
  nrow = terra::nrow(r),
  ncol = terra::ncol(r),
  byrow = TRUE
)

dim(m)
```

```{r}
m_plot <- t(m)[, nrow(m):1]
image(m_plot)
```

```{r}
kampala <- dplyr::filter(roi_sf, NAME_1 == "Kampala")
```

```{r}
r_kampala <- r %>%
  terra::crop(kampala) %>%
  terra::mask(kampala)
```

```{r}
kampala_buffer <- terra::buffer(kampala, 10)

r_kampala_square <- terra::crop(r, kampala_buffer)
```

```{r}
plot(r_kampala_square)
plot(kampala_buffer, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
library(genlasso)

# Usa il raster RETTANGOLARE (senza maschera) per mantenere la griglia
v <- terra::values(r_kampala_square)
nr <- terra::nrow(r_kampala_square)
nc <- terra::ncol(r_kampala_square)

# Sostituisci NA con 0 (o la media) per mantenere la struttura griglia
v[is.na(v)] <- 0

y <- as.numeric(v)

# Matrice di penalità 2D
D <- getD2d(nr, nc)

# Fit
fit <- fusedlasso(y = y, D = D)
```

```{r}
# Fit
m <- matrix(v, nrow = nr, ncol = nc)
fit <- fusedlasso2d(m)

fit
```

```{r}
# Estrai coefficienti a un dato lambda
coef_fit <- coef(fit, lambda = 5)$beta
m_smooth <- matrix(coef_fit, nrow = nr, ncol = nc)
image(t(m_smooth)[, nrow(m_smooth):1])
```

```{r}
range(fit$lambda)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
for (lam in quantile(fit$lambda, c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.9))) {
  coef_fit <- coef(fit, lambda = lam)$beta
  m_smooth <- matrix(coef_fit, nrow = nr, ncol = nc)
  image(t(m_smooth)[, nrow(m_smooth):1], 
        main = paste("lambda =", round(lam, 3)))
}
```

```{r}
library(viridis)

coef_fit <- coef(fit, lambda = 0.6)$beta
m_smooth <- matrix(coef_fit, nrow = nr, ncol = nc)

image(t(m_smooth)[, nrow(m_smooth):1], 
      col = viridis(100),
      main = "Fused Lasso 2D - Kampala (λ = 0.6)")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Originale
image(t(m)[, nrow(m):1], 
      col = viridis(100),
      main = "Originale")

# Smoothed
coef_fit <- coef(fit, lambda = 0.6)$beta
m_smooth <- matrix(coef_fit, nrow = nr, ncol = nc)
image(t(m_smooth)[, nrow(m_smooth):1], 
      col = viridis(100),
      main = "Fused Lasso (λ = 0.6)")
```

```{r}
# Rimetti i coefficienti smoothed nel raster originale
r_smooth <- r_kampala_square  # copia la struttura (extent, crs, ecc.)

coef_fit <- coef(fit, lambda = 0.6)$beta
terra::values(r_smooth) <- coef_fit

# Ora confronta con le coordinate geografiche corrette
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(r_kampala_square, main = "Originale")
plot(kampala_buffer, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)

plot(r_smooth, main = "Fused Lasso (λ = 0.6)")
plot(kampala_buffer, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
lim <- range(values(r_kampala_square), na.rm = TRUE)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(r_kampala_square, main = "Originale", range = lim)
plot(kampala_buffer, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)

plot(r_smooth, main = "Fused Lasso (λ = 0.6)", range = lim)
plot(kampala_buffer, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)
```
